reference: Protected six-model stoppage consensus; unchanged frame_closure from adaptive seed42 intersection screen.
objective_history: All earlier broadcast plans fail their short-match and/or substantial gates. This separate prospective confirmation tests an incremental primary-score gain; it does not claim passing those plans. Seeds43/44 have not yet been evaluated for this method.
inference: Unchanged decode_broadcast_closure: strictly aligned broadcast geometry, joint-frame classifier only where broadcast ball is observed, fixed11-frame source closure without intersection, all referenceD preserved. No frame IDs or true endpoints in inference.
training: Unchanged original eligible public folds and frame-balanced joint XGBoost; seed42 must reproduce stored raw probabilities and source-closure predictions exactly.

promotion.all_pairs: Primary>=reference+.01; MacroF1>=reference-.001; mean short IoU>=reference; no previously mostly recovered short run lost; identical D masks; official IoU.5 spurious and missed possession counts may not increase.
promotion.each_protocol: Strictly positive mean primary gain across seeds.
promotion.report_substantial_separately: Original buffered+.04 criterion must be reported separately; it is not the incremental criterion.
promotion.deployment: Before selection: official scoring, all model/source/input/cache and shared-inference checks, reproducible full-match candidate and independent Standards/Spec review. Record all clipped-block regressions.

limitations: Adaptive same-match repeated-label development; unused seeds are correlated stress checks, not independent labels or selection-adjusted evidence. Maximum/private full-match accuracy remains unverified.

provenance_revision.reason: Independent review required path-independent camera asset identities; no method, threshold, split, target, feature or prediction change. Original frozen plan and all pre-repair artifacts preserved at data/control_broadcast_v1/provenance_before/.
